props.title: The Benefits of Virgin Coconut Oil Massage
props.text: Virgin cold-pressed coconut oil is made from fresh coconuts without high heat, helping preserve its natural properties. In massage therapy, it is valued for its smooth texture, skin-conditioning benefits, and suitability for most skin types. Combined with relaxing massage techniques, it creates a treatment that supports both muscle relaxation and skin nourishment.
props.feature1Text: Retains the natural qualities of fresh coconut through minimal processing.
props.feature2Text: Lightweight, nourishing, and suitable for most skin types.

items.question: What makes virgin cold-pressed coconut oil different from regular massage oil?
items.answer: Virgin cold-pressed coconut oil is made from fresh coconuts without high heat, which helps preserve its natural composition. Many people prefer it to regular massage oil because it feels lightweight on the skin, gives natural moisture and supports smooth, flowing strokes. Spa Bali Moon uses it for its full-body coconut oil massage in Seminyak.

items.question: Is this massage suitable for sensitive skin?
items.answer: For most people, yes. Virgin coconut oil is generally well tolerated and comfortable on most skin types. If you have a coconut allergy or specific skin concerns, please tell Spa Bali Moon before your appointment, for example when you book on WhatsApp. The pressure of the coconut oil massage can also be adjusted to suit you.

items.question: Will the massage leave my skin feeling oily?
items.answer: Only slightly. A light layer of oil may remain straight after a virgin coconut oil massage at Spa Bali Moon, but much of the oil is absorbed during the massage, leaving the skin feeling soft, moisturised and comfortable. Sessions run 1 hour, 1.5 hours or 2 hours, from IDR 300.000 per person.

items.question: Can I book this massage as a home service?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon offers the virgin coconut oil massage at our Seminyak spa and as a home service at villas and hotels throughout Seminyak and nearby areas. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist to the session price, from IDR 300.000 per person for 1 hour. Book on WhatsApp, and mention any coconut allergy.

items.question: Is this massage only for relaxation?
items.answer: No. Relaxation is one of its main benefits, but many guests also choose the virgin coconut oil massage at Spa Bali Moon because the oil helps keep the skin feeling soft, smooth and moisturised. It is a popular choice after sun, beach days or outdoor activities, and for guests with dry-feeling skin.

items.question: Is virgin coconut oil massage suitable for dry skin?
items.answer: Yes, it can be. Virgin coconut oil massage can suit dry or dehydrated-feeling skin because the coconut oil helps moisturise and soften the skin. Individual skin types can respond differently to oils, so if you have known sensitivities, tell your Spa Bali Moon therapist before treatment.

items.question: Can virgin coconut oil massage help with muscle tension?
items.answer: Yes, mainly through the massage itself. The techniques used in Spa Bali Moon's virgin coconut oil massage can help relax tight or tired muscles and promote overall physical relaxation. The benefit depends on pressure, technique and your needs rather than the oil. Booking 1.5 hours (IDR 440.000 per person) gives extra attention to tired muscles.

items.question: How much does a coconut oil massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A virgin coconut oil massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 300.000 for 1 hour, IDR 440.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 580.000 for 2 hours per person. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist. We accept Visa, Mastercard or cash, and you can book on WhatsApp.
